title: Categorical encoding protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Categorical encoding should complete this objective: Encode categorical columns. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Build numerical feature matrices.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Show how unseen categories and missing categories are handled.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for OneHotEncoder, handle_unknown, ColumnTransformer and does not run the learner code. Show how unseen categories and missing categories are handled.
